column1: # Game profile of Super Mario Maker 2, update 3.0.3 (v458752).
# Nintendo sead / agl / gsys, SDK 7.3.2, NVN; see README.md for validation.
# Handheld exposes the game touchscreen used by the course editor.
# All controller buttons remain available below the picture in Duo portrait.
# The game records conditional rendering during boot; replay its predicates on the GPU.
# Render jobs race scene setup and teardown on other guest threads (g3d materials, ui2d draw state, command buffers): run one guest thread at a time.
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
